accepted_input_shape: Exact staging packet, three unique retained recipients, current requested mailbox absent; or an already-prepared four-recipient packet with that mailbox present.
operation: Preserve all three retained addresses, case and order. Append one normalized explicit current test mailbox. Change only recipient JSON in a new CurrentUser DPAPI packet. Keep original packet unchanged and verify encrypted readback. Copy recipient-address JSON only to clipboard.
unexpected_counts_duplicate_or_foreign_s: Refuse without recipient JSON or configuration changes.

manual_following_action.value: Prepared four-address JSON; existing three plus current private test mailbox. Review that existing approved recipients are retained before saving.
manual_following_action.deployment: After saving this one setting in both environments of the staging project, upload the newly prepared signout-entry ZIP to apply the new value and published signout UI correction in one staging deployment.
manual_following_action.source_secret_values_are_deployment_boun: Reviewed established workflow; no independent live secret-value readback.

next_owner_return: Safe preparation JSON, new deployment URL and confirmation the recipient setting was saved in both staging-project environments. Paste clipboard into Cloudflare before copying console output.
